quotes.name: Poison Dart Frog
quotes.flavor:
"Bright as any dinosaur—and just as with other great hunters, its colors are a warning."
—Huatli

quotes.name: Culling Ritual
quotes.flavor: "Now is the time... for the death of you all!"

quotes.name: Merrow Bonegnawer
quotes.flavor: Banished to the Dark Meanders for hideous crimes, some merrows find a taste for the darkness . . . and the dead.

quotes.name: Demon's Grasp
quotes.flavor:
"Take what solace you can in the knowledge that you will not be here to witness Zendikar's demise."
—Ob Nixilis

quotes.name: Profane Procession // Tomb of the Dusk Rose
quotes.flavor: Vona sought a conqueror. Mavren sought a savior. Both found what they sought . . .

quotes.name: Raging Goblin
quotes.flavor: He raged at the world, at his family, at his life. But mostly he just raged.

quotes.name: Orzhov Signet
quotes.flavor: The sigil holds different meanings depending on its form and presentation. While some wear it as a sign of status, others wear it as a sign of debt.

quotes.name: Plague Rats
quotes.flavor: During the dark times, the rats seemed to grow ever stronger.

quotes.name: Desolate Lighthouse
quotes.flavor: A lonely sentinel facing gales, hurricanes, and tides of homicidal spirits.

quotes.name: Brainstorm
quotes.flavor: "My Spider-Sense again. It's never tingled like this before."

quotes.name: Brigone, Soldier of Meletis
quotes.flavor: "Gods, guide my hand!"

quotes.name: Blessed Respite
quotes.flavor:
"Water the soil with blood, if you must. Eventually it must be tilled with forgiveness."
—Greensleeves

quotes.name: Repulse
quotes.flavor: "You aren't invited."

quotes.name: Maw of Kozilek
quotes.flavor:
"The Eldrazi make worse than ruins—they make a world where not even ruins stand."
—Gideon Jura

quotes.name: Eternal Witness
quotes.flavor: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

quotes.name: Commander's Sphere
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

quotes.name: Pathmaker Initiate
quotes.flavor: "The expected way through the trial is far too tedious."

quotes.name: Revive
quotes.flavor: Even what is lost beyond recall returns when coaxed by a dryad's hand.

quotes.name: Aether Spellbomb
quotes.flavor:
"Release that which was never caged."
—Spellbomb inscription

quotes.name: Combo Attack
quotes.flavor: Success at Valor's Reach requires not only individual skill but also the ability to merge that skill with a partner's.

quotes.name: Colossal Might
quotes.flavor:
"Never corner a barbarian. You become the path of least resistance."
—Sarkhan Vol

quotes.name: Declare Dominance
quotes.flavor:
"If you think yourself a chief, then prove your might."
—Gar-Tun, Mistvalley silverback

quotes.name: Mirari's Wake
quotes.flavor: The land drank power from the Mirari as though it had thirsted forever.

quotes.name: Gray Merchant of Asphodel
quotes.flavor: They say you can't take it with you, but he's out to prove them wrong.

quotes.name: Hijack
quotes.flavor: Trapped on Ixalan, the Planeswalker Angrath is the only minotaur sailing the seas. No matter how many ships he captures, he cannot break free.

quotes.name: Feast of the Unicorn
quotes.flavor:
"Some delicacies are not to be savored, save by the callous."
—Baron Sengir

quotes.name: Rampant Growth
quotes.flavor: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

quotes.name: Thornado
quotes.flavor: Today's Forecast: Thorny

quotes.name: Ogre Taskmaster
quotes.flavor: Three little goblins, enjoying their brew. One bumped an ogre, and then there were two.

quotes.name: J. Jonah Jameson
quotes.flavor: "The photos are garbage, Parker! I'll buy them all."

quotes.name: Scorch Spitter
quotes.flavor:
"Yes, she can be a nuisance. But at least my tea never gets cold."
—Marlan Farthwald, innkeeper

quotes.name: Confiscate
quotes.flavor:
"I don't understand why he works so hard on a device to duplicate a sound so easily made with hand and armpit."
—Barrin, progress report

quotes.name: Sculpting Steel
quotes.flavor: An artificer once dropped one in a vault full of coins. She has yet to find it.

quotes.name: Blood Pet
quotes.flavor: "You are wrong," Volrath said. "I do not hate the living. They often prove quite useful to me." And then he laughed.

quotes.name: Tajuru Stalwart
quotes.flavor: "In its time of hardship, all of Zendikar cries out in pain. Are you listening?"

quotes.name: Go for the Throat
quotes.flavor: Having flesh is increasingly a liability on Mirrodin.

quotes.name: Contraband Kingpin
quotes.flavor: "Don't waste my time with trifles. Bring me works of art, and I will make you rich."

quotes.name: Claim the Firstborn
quotes.flavor:
"Will! They have a copy of *Tales of the Fae* here! Want me to read you a bedtime story?"
—Rowan Kenrith

quotes.name: Kabira Takedown // Kabira Plateau
quotes.flavor:
"Down below's where things go to die."
—Kreq of Sunder Bay

quotes.name: Mind Stone
quotes.flavor:
"Not by age but by capacity is wisdom gained."
—Titus Maccius Plautus, *Trinummus*

quotes.name: Winter Orb
quotes.flavor:
"When once winter has ahold,
Not willingly does she withdraw
Her icy touch, wistfully caressing—
The deepened air sleeps its cold."
—Aline Corralurn, "Late Thaw"

quotes.name: Man-o'-War
quotes.flavor:
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

quotes.name: Abrade
quotes.flavor:
「僕たちは発見された遺物から多くの学びを得る。失われた遺物からは、どんな学びを得られただろうね？」
――キーロル

quotes.name: Caves of Koilos
quotes.flavor: After years of silence, the caves once again echo with the grisly sounds of Phyrexians preparing for war.

quotes.name: Vitu-Ghazi Guildmage
quotes.flavor: "Preachers of freedom forget that conformity can be beautiful."

quotes.name: Azorius Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter the Senate, the seat of justice and the foundation of Ravnican society.

quotes.name: Jeska's Will
quotes.flavor:
"Gather your strength. Prepare yourself."
—Jeska, to Radha

quotes.name: Tooth of Ramos
quotes.flavor: Ramos smiled, and there was day.

quotes.name: Palace Guard
quotes.flavor: "I'm not nearly as bothered by being outnumbered as I am by their foul stench."

quotes.name: Aura Gnarlid
quotes.flavor: Kill a gnarlid with your first blow, or it'll cheerfully show you how it's done.

quotes.name: Displaced Dinosaurs
quotes.flavor:
"Good grief! It's a stegosaurus. What a splendid specimen."
—The Third Doctor

quotes.name: Shrapnel Blast
quotes.flavor: From trinket to trauma.

quotes.name: D'Avenant Archer
quotes.flavor: Avenant's archers are also trained as poets, so that each arrow is guided by a fragment of verse.

quotes.name: Denethor, Ruling Steward
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "Much must be risked in war."

quotes.name: Sandcrafter Mage
quotes.flavor: With heat, sand can form a delicate work of art; with pressure, an impenetrable bulwark.

quotes.name: Topaz Dragon // Entropic Cloud
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: What its gaze doesn't wither, its breath surely will.

quotes.name: Stone Idol Generator
quotes.flavor:
"Like my people's ambitions, it is both awe-inspiring and unfinished."
—Nahiri

quotes.name: Supply Caravan
quotes.flavor:
"We each have a weight to carry on the road to the afterlife."
—Oketra, god of solidarity

quotes.name: Soldevi Sage
quotes.flavor:
"Our underground archives grow daily, as our excavators and sages alike dig to uncover hidden wonders."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

quotes.name: Mutagen Connoisseur
quotes.flavor: Much to the Phyrexians' delight, sheer curiosity drove many to willingly surrender to *compleation*.

quotes.name: Boldwyr Aggressor
quotes.flavor: During the Invasion, Clan Boldwyr's defense of their dolmens was legendary. Now they're more territorial than ever.

quotes.name: Confiscate
quotes.flavor: "But I brought enough for the whole class!"

quotes.name: Persistent Petitioners
quotes.flavor: ". . . you must open the gates of the Shredforge to all, but also . . ."

quotes.name: Starfield Mystic
quotes.flavor: "The realm of the gods opens before me!"

quotes.name: Master's Rebuke
quotes.flavor: "You have always been a promising student, but your arrogance far outstrips your prowess."

quotes.name: Escape from Orthanc
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"How far can you bear me?" asked Gandalf.
"Many leagues," said Gwaihir, "but not to the ends of the earth. I was sent to bear tidings, not burdens."

quotes.name: Jeering Homunculus
quotes.flavor: Mklthd had always hated crowds . . . and they had always hated him.

quotes.name: War Behemoth
quotes.flavor:
"The Houses always hope for peace, but we always pack for war."
—Gvar Barzeel, krumar commander

quotes.name: Fortify
quotes.flavor:
"Where metal is tainted and wood is scarce, we are best armed by faith."
—Tavalus, acolyte of Korlis

quotes.name: Gluttonous Zombie
quotes.flavor: Greed and gluttony led him to death. Now they are his greatest assets.

quotes.name: Avacyn's Pilgrim
quotes.flavor: "Avacyn's protection is everywhere. From the holy church to the sacred glade, all that we see is under her blessed watch."

quotes.name: Raul, Trouble Shooter
quotes.flavor: "Raul Alfonso Tejada, former gunslinger and sole survivor of Hidalgo Ranch, at your service."

quotes.name: Bristling Boar
quotes.flavor:
"I can bring down anything in Zagoth, but for some quarry the ratio of fight to meat is too high."
—Master Hunter Chevill

quotes.name: Unhallowed Phalanx
quotes.flavor:
"In case any of you new recruits were wondering, this is why we don't use mass graves anymore."
—Kerren of the Mausoleum Guards

quotes.name: Wrath of Marit Lage
quotes.flavor:
"Marit Lage lies frozen in a glacier's heart. Still her dreams take form in our world, stealing the heat from our souls."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran priest

quotes.name: Expropriate
quotes.flavor: Could be worse. You had a choice.

quotes.name: Skyknight Legionnaire
quotes.flavor:
"I do not know which gives me more pride: the legions of soldiers marching in thunderous lockstep, or the cry of the skyknights riding their rocs like jagged lightning overhead."
—Razia

quotes.name: Urza's Mine
quotes.flavor: Mines became common as cities during the days of the artificers.

quotes.name: Memnite
quotes.flavor: Reminders of Memnarch's reign still skirr across Mirrodin, reminiscent of his form if not his power.

quotes.name: Prairie Stream
quotes.flavor: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

quotes.name: Dark Maze
quotes.flavor:
"The path of faith is fortunately fraught with failure."
—Irini Sengir

quotes.name: Time to Reflect
quotes.flavor:
"Occasionally, there are those who refuse to appreciate all that the God-Pharaoh provides for us."
—Temmet, vizier of Naktamun

quotes.name: Mortify
quotes.flavor: The queen sent her champion to defeat the necromancer threat. His helmet was returned the next day, warped and stained with blood.

quotes.name: Wonder
quotes.flavor:
"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

quotes.name: Experimental Frenzy
quotes.flavor: コーヒーは発明の偏屈な叔母であるのだ。

quotes.name: Battlefield Forge
quotes.flavor:
"Welcome to the new world order."
—Rufus Shinra

quotes.name: Spawning Grounds
quotes.flavor: It's the only water source in miles of desert, but the local tribes avoid it at all costs.

quotes.name: Wellwisher
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Elves vs. Goblins
quotes.flavor: "Close your ears to the voice of greed, and you can turn a gift for one into a gift for many."

quotes.name: Morbid Opportunist
quotes.flavor: On Innistrad, one person's windfall usually starts with another person lying face down in the mud.

quotes.name: Flayed One
quotes.flavor: Those suspected of carrying the flayer curse are summarily banished, lest the corruption spread to other Necrons.

quotes.name: Stensia Bloodhall
quotes.flavor: The revelry ends when the supply of fresh ingenues runs dry.

quotes.name: Pull from Tomorrow
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"I do things in my own time."
—Etha, initiate of Rhet crop

quotes.name: Cradle Guard
quotes.flavor:
Mother, sleep / Dream our lives
Our roots your soul / Our leaves your bed.

quotes.name: Rancor
quotes.flavor: Hatred outlives the hateful.

quotes.name: Marsh Viper
quotes.flavor:
"And the seraphs sob at vermin fangs
In human gore imbued."
—Edgar Allan Poe, "The Conqueror Wurm"

quotes.name: Tomb of the Spirit Dragon
quotes.flavor:
"The voice calls me here, yet I see only bones. Is this more dragon trickery?"
—Sarkhan Vol

quotes.name: Mobilized District
quotes.flavor: Sometimes the strongest weapon you can hold in your hand is another hand.

quotes.name: Razorfin Abolisher
quotes.flavor: Once you have been marked by the merrow, you are not long for their waters.

quotes.name: Cerulean Drake
quotes.flavor: Dragons avoid the bright colors of its wings.

quotes.name: Stromkirk Patrol
quotes.flavor: "You'd best move along, human. Our palates are far less discerning than our master's."

quotes.name: Viseling
quotes.flavor: "This may hurt a lot."

quotes.name: Molten Blast
quotes.flavor: Life among the sudden tremors and violent eruptions of Akoum demands a healthy fear of both.

quotes.name: Shatterstorm
quotes.flavor: Chains of leaping fire and sizzling lightning laid waste the artificers' handiwork, sparing not a single device.

quotes.name: Naya Battlemage
quotes.flavor: "I have trained in all three schools of magic."

quotes.name: Hunting Triad
quotes.flavor: "Eyeblights are easy to track. Just follow the imperfections."

quotes.name: Energy Flux
quotes.flavor: Karn said nothing—he just grasped the powerstone and squeezed tightly. The wild flashing ceased.

quotes.name: Wight of the Reliquary
quotes.flavor: Her new demonic overlords prized her knowledge of Bant's landscape.

quotes.name: Six-y Beast
quotes.flavor: Is it six?

quotes.name: Azorius Justiciar
quotes.flavor: "Your potential to commit a crime warrants further investigation."

quotes.name: Hypnotic Specter
quotes.flavor: "...There was no trace/ Of aught on that illumined face..." —Samuel Coleridge, "Phantom"

quotes.name: Devouring Light
quotes.flavor: "Even your shadow is too foul to tolerate."

quotes.name: Veteran of the Depths
quotes.flavor: In the backwaters of the Merrow Lanes lie stones scarred with tallies of countless generations, each representing a victory of merrow soldiers.

quotes.name: No Rest for the Wicked
quotes.flavor:
"The soul? Here, we have no use for such frivolities."
—Sitrik, birth priest

quotes.name: Sandsteppe Citadel
quotes.flavor: That which endures, survives.

quotes.name: Kargan Dragonrider
quotes.flavor: "Only those who give the dragons the respect they deserve may bear our title."

quotes.name: Cyclops of One-Eyed Pass
quotes.flavor:
The Champion armed herself to face the cyclops, heedless of her companions' despair. "How will you defeat it with only one spear?" asked young Althemone. The Champion raised her weapon. "It has but one eye."
—*The Theriad*

quotes.name: Mind's Eye
quotes.flavor: "Ideas drift like petals on the wind. I have only to lift my face to the breeze."

quotes.name: Hour of Reckoning
quotes.flavor:
"Ravnica, like a hedge, must be pruned, leaving only leaves of verdant uniformity."
—Niszka, Selesnya evangel

quotes.name: Archetype of Endurance
quotes.flavor: Despite its fearsome stature, it is as elusive as a shadow, circling round to stalk those who presume to hunt it.

quotes.name: Swiftfoot Boots
quotes.flavor:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

quotes.name: The Mechanist, Aerial Artisan
quotes.flavor: "We're just in the process of improving upon what's already here."

quotes.name: Wildwood Geist
quotes.flavor: The geists that dwell in the deep forests of Kessig are as untamable as the woods themselves.

quotes.name: Samite Healer
quotes.flavor: Healers ultimately acquire the divine gifts of spiritual and physical wholeness. The most devout are also granted the ability to pass physical wholeness on to others.

quotes.name: Vampiric Tutor
quotes.flavor: True power is achieved through blood and sweat. But mostly blood.

quotes.name: Manamorphose
quotes.flavor: For a moment, objects of pure mana glimmered in the wonderstruck boggart's hands. In the next moment, they were in his mouth, as he chewed contentedly.

quotes.name: Radiating Lightning
quotes.flavor: As the Cabal legions pushed into Shiv, they learned not to stand so close together.

quotes.name: Congregate
quotes.flavor:
"In the gathering there is strength for all who founder, renewal for all who languish, love for all who sing."
—*Song of All*, canto 642

quotes.name: Kraul Swarm
quotes.flavor: The hive has a long memory. It knows how every member ever died, and to whom it owes the grudge.

quotes.name: Dungrove Elder
quotes.flavor: All the trees of the forest are his army, and every leaf his shield.

quotes.name: Goblin Flotilla
quotes.flavor: Exceptionally poor sailors, Goblins usually arrived at their destination retching and in no condition to fight.

quotes.name: Merciless Executioner
quotes.flavor: "Curse the Isengarders! Uglúk u bagronk sha pushdug Saruman-glob búbhosh skai!"

quotes.name: Miirym, Sentinel Wyrm
quotes.flavor: The most terrifying thing a dragon can be is well-read.

quotes.name: Talisman of Indulgence
quotes.flavor:
"Embrace your hunger, your lust, your desire. The universe is ours for the taking!"
—Sanctifer LeVay, Cult of the Sacred Union

quotes.name: Wakeroot Elemental
quotes.flavor:
"When the forest walks, it's too late to run."
—Horent, Khalni druid

quotes.name: Arcum's Astrolabe
quotes.flavor: Though the Time of Ice has ended, its relics still slumber in New Argive.

quotes.name: Woodland Cemetery
quotes.flavor:
"Motive power nil. Total loss of vision. Sensor plates not functioning, and weaponry deactivated."
—The Third Doctor

quotes.name: Savannah Lions
quotes.flavor: The traditional kings of the jungle command a healthy respect in other climates as well. Relying mainly on their stealth and speed, Savannah Lions can take a victim by surprise, even in the endless, flat plains of their homeland.

quotes.name: Hardened Scales
quotes.flavor:
"They're herbivores, not prey animals. Go startle one if you want to know the difference."
—Huatli

quotes.name: Parallel Lives
quotes.flavor:
"Brave Syr Armont mused: Was the elves' true nature that of day's civility or night's savagery? Could such bestial rage be bestowed by curse alone?"
—*Curse of the Werefox*

quotes.name: Hammerhead Shark
quotes.flavor: Cross the eyes of a hammerhead and you'll dot its teeth.

quotes.name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
quotes.flavor: When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot. The frog that ate the maggot grew and grew, until a ravenous spirit burst from its body.

quotes.name: Warstorm Surge
quotes.flavor: "Listen to the roar! Feel the thunder! The Immersturm shouts its approval with every bolt of lightning!"

quotes.name: Temporal Adept
quotes.flavor:
"Of course she's at the head of her class. All of her classmates have disappeared."
—Tolarian renegade

quotes.name: Ghor-Clan Rampager
quotes.flavor:
"The Simic come from the cold slow depths. How could they understand the fire in a wild heart?"
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

quotes.name: Puppet Conjurer
quotes.flavor: He scowls at his imperfect creation, then crushes it to scrap. He salvages the etherium and begins anew.

quotes.name: Zealous Strike
quotes.flavor: "Cower, fiend. The night is yours no longer."

quotes.name: Flare
quotes.flavor:
"In the forest, fires light the sky as black clouds unfold their weight."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

quotes.name: Soltari Emissary
quotes.flavor: Alone at the portal, Ertai began his meditation. He realized immediately that he was not alone.

quotes.name: Eriette of the Charmed Apple
quotes.flavor: "Hush now. I need your beauty sleep."

quotes.name: Desynchronization
quotes.flavor: History cannot be changed, and the Animus is not kind to those who try.

quotes.name: Failed Inspection
quotes.flavor: The most dangerous thing an artificer can do is believe an invention is perfect.

quotes.name: Winds of Change
quotes.flavor:
"'Tis the set of sails and not the gales Which tells us the way to go."
—Ella Wheeler Wilcox, "Winds of Fate"

quotes.name: Lozhan, Dragons' Legacy
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: She channels myth and memory into waves of deadly arcane force.

quotes.name: Hill Giant
quotes.flavor: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

quotes.name: Yellow Scarves General
quotes.flavor: Zhang Jue, leader of the Yellow Scarves rebellion, was a Taoist master and tutored his soldiers in those arts.

quotes.name: Dragon Hatchling
quotes.flavor:
"Those dragons grow fast. For a while they feed on squirrels and goblins and then suddenly you're missing a mammoth."
—Hurdek, Mazar mammoth trainer

quotes.name: Sunken Hollow
quotes.flavor: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

quotes.name: Order of Leitbur
quotes.flavor:
"The powers of the corrupt will fade before the fury of the pure."
—Bethan Leitbur, "The Way"

quotes.name: Krenko's Command
quotes.flavor: Goblins are eager to follow orders, especially when those orders involve stealing, hurting, annoying, eating, destroying, or swearing.

quotes.name: Prizefight
quotes.flavor: Underweight, underpaid, underestimated.

quotes.name: Breaching Hippocamp
quotes.flavor: Don't try to ride this steed unless you've got gills too.

quotes.name: Pitiless Plunderer
quotes.flavor: "Shame to let good gold go to the grave."

quotes.name: Muddle the Mixture
quotes.flavor:
Whatever you desire—
To MUDDLE
Or MIX...
I'm your fix.

quotes.name: Sunlit Marsh
quotes.flavor: Even the poisoned land around the Stronghold blossomed with new life in the wake of the Great Mending.

quotes.name: Paragon of Modernity
quotes.flavor: No true angels have been created since the founding of New Capenna, but artisans have learned to craft elegant facsimiles.

quotes.name: Gilded Scuttler
quotes.flavor: "ATTENTION BEACHGOERS: This is a litter-free zone. Violators will be pinched."

quotes.name: Thunderbreak Regent
quotes.flavor: Attracting a dragon's attention may be the last mistake you make.

quotes.name: Thriving Moor
quotes.flavor: Beauty appears in strange places for those with eyes to see it.

quotes.name: Eldrazi Temple
quotes.flavor: Each temple is a door to a horrible future.

quotes.name: Alela, Artful Provocateur
quotes.flavor: The children shouted in glee as the parents gasped in fear.

quotes.name: Absorb
quotes.flavor: "In your misguided attempt to subvert the law, you have eloquently explained why the law must exist."

quotes.name: Oketra's Monument
quotes.flavor:
"The worthy shall respect the worthy. In the afterlife, all will stand united."
—Monument inscription

quotes.name: Debtors' Transport
quotes.flavor: By design, the sarcophagus muffles the debtors' moans but does not silence them.

quotes.name: Coral Eel
quotes.flavor: Some fishers like to eat eels, and some eels like to eat fishers.

quotes.name: Dream Stalker
quotes.flavor: What happens when it is the dream that wakes and the sleeper that fades into memory?

quotes.name: Graveborn Muse
quotes.flavor:
"Her voice is damnation, unyielding and certain."
—Phage the Untouchable

quotes.name: Drownyard Temple
quotes.flavor:
"This is it! All the cryptoliths point here!"
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Arni Brokenbrow
quotes.flavor: "I headbutted a troll. And won."

quotes.name: Primal Order
quotes.flavor:
"It's strange, but I can feel it when the land is corrupted. I understand why the Autumn Willow is so protective."
—Daria

quotes.name: Eternal Witness
quotes.flavor: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

quotes.name: Maelstrom Pulse
quotes.flavor: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

quotes.name: Sinister Sabotage
quotes.flavor:
"We have intel that some guilds have fallen under an invader's influence. Until we're sure, no venture succeeds."
—Lazav

quotes.name: Juggernaut
quotes.flavor: The goblins built it far larger than the cave opening, but to their glee, it smashed into the mountainside, ripping itself a new exit.

quotes.name: Volrath's Stronghold
quotes.flavor: The seed of a world's evil.

quotes.name: Flickerwisp
quotes.flavor: Its wings disturb more than air.

quotes.name: Bone Saw
quotes.flavor:
"When metal instruments are scarce, a saw constructed from the subject's femur will suffice for a craniectomy."
—Ashnod, research notes

quotes.name: Shady Traveler // Stalking Predator
quotes.flavor: The stranger spoke to no one, and the townspeople gladly returned the favor.

quotes.name: Troll of Khazad-dûm
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"A great cave-troll, I think. There is no hope of escape that way."
—Gandalf

quotes.name: Bellowing Mauler
quotes.flavor: He's pretty sure he can't get charged with murder if he calls it "organic demolition."

quotes.name: Moment of Glory
quotes.flavor: "I am Bard, slayer of the Dragon!"

quotes.name: Plow Through
quotes.flavor: Like most goblins, Rocketeers value nothing more than a good old-fashioned near-death experience.

quotes.name: Terramorphic Expanse
quotes.flavor: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

quotes.name: Wild Cantor
quotes.flavor: They are the voice of the wild, crying out with nature's fury and bringing forth its primeval might.

quotes.name: Auriok Glaivemaster
quotes.flavor: "Give me a bit of steel and I'll deliver it into the hearts of my enemies."

quotes.name: Lionheart Glimmer
quotes.flavor: The survivors would no longer be picked off one by one. It was their turn to hunt.

quotes.name: Supply-Line Cranes
quotes.flavor: They are trained from hatching to deliver aid where it is needed most.

quotes.name: Abzan Guide
quotes.flavor: "These roads are desolate and changeable. Follow me, or die in the wastes."

quotes.name: Mockingbird
quotes.flavor: "Don't worry, your secrets are safe with me!" the birdfolk called back in the ratfolk's own voice.

quotes.name: Phytohydra
quotes.flavor:
"Look at this creature, so like the Conclave it serves. Cut one head and it grows two. Damage it and it flourishes."
—Veszka, Selesnya evangel

quotes.name: Champion of the Parish
quotes.flavor: "I stand for every cobbler, tanner, and fool in this town—and they stand for me."

quotes.name: Dramatic Finale
quotes.flavor: The enraptured audience barely noticed their programs were suddenly blank.

quotes.name: Spellseeker
quotes.flavor: Mages and warriors recruited from across Kylem display their skills at Valor's Reach.

quotes.name: Spidersilk Net
quotes.flavor: "Dragons are our betters, but we will fight them if our dragonlord orders it."

quotes.name: Stark Industries Executive
quotes.flavor:
"Tony's ideas are . . . expensive. Someone has to make sure we can put them into practice."
—Pepper Potts

quotes.name: Mana Leak
quotes.flavor: The fatal flaw in every plan is the assumption that you know more than your enemy.

quotes.name: Authority of the Consuls
quotes.flavor:
"He must be guilty of something or other, or he wouldn't have attempted to flee the Empire."
—Yotsuyu goe Brutus

quotes.name: Swiftblade Vindicator
quotes.flavor: A swiftblade is an artist, each fiery trail of their blades a fleeting masterpiece traced on the air.

quotes.name: Smash
quotes.flavor:
"They're ugly, and they're in my way."
—Tahngarth

quotes.name: Extract from Darkness
quotes.flavor: If you want to wreak havoc above, sometimes it's best to look below.

quotes.name: Ugin's Insight
quotes.flavor:
"You speak to me of the threat of Ulamog. But do not forget: they came as three."
—Ugin, to Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Neglected Heirloom // Ashmouth Blade
quotes.flavor:
"Its previous owners had some stories to share, I'm certain."
—Old Rutstein

quotes.name: Curate
quotes.flavor: "Aha! This must be one of the ancient keys to... No, wait. It's just another puzzle toy."

quotes.name: Spellshock
quotes.flavor: A snap of fingers, a snap of teeth.

quotes.name: Kraken's Eye
quotes.flavor: Bright as a mirror, dark as the sea.

quotes.name: Devoted Caretaker
quotes.flavor: Her eyes blaze with the strength of twenty shields. Every glance is a salvation.

quotes.name: Prison Realm
quotes.flavor: After millennia to craft victory, Bolas had eternity to contemplate defeat.

quotes.name: Dust to Dust
quotes.flavor:
"All this nonsense made by mages
Rusts and crumbles through the ages."
—Aline Corralurn, "Inheritance"

quotes.name: Spikefield Hazard // Spikefield Cave
quotes.flavor:
"Stop screaming! You'll only bring down more spikes."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter

quotes.name: Universal Surveillance
quotes.flavor: Few outside the Saiba Futurists know the true extent of their data-extraction network.

quotes.name: Rag Man
quotes.flavor: "Aw, he's just a silly, dirty little man. What's to be afraid of?"

quotes.name: Brainstone
quotes.flavor: One day, it might provide a flash of insight that turns the tide of battle. Meanwhile, it looks lovely on an end table.

quotes.name: Fire Snake
quotes.flavor: The snake's final thrashings only spread the fire within it.

quotes.name: Shivan Dragon
quotes.flavor: While it's true most dragons are cruel, the Shivan dragon seems to take particular glee in the misery of others, often tormenting its victims much like a cat plays with a mouse before delivering the final blow.

quotes.name: Thran Dynamo
quotes.flavor: Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.

quotes.name: No One Will Hear Your Cries
quotes.flavor: "Your companions were lucky to have died first."

quotes.name: Obscuring Haze
quotes.flavor: Whether hunter or hunted, Kathril chooses when it is seen.

quotes.name: Ajani's Pridemate
quotes.flavor:
"When one of us prospers, the pride prospers."
—Jazal Goldmane

quotes.name: Shadow of the Second Sun
quotes.flavor: Live fully, then return to the beginning.

quotes.name: Hill Giant
quotes.flavor: Fortunately, Hill Giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

quotes.name: Cloudheath Drake
quotes.flavor: A permanent storm rages over the plain of Cloudheath, and drakes ride its currents—two reminders that some elements of Esper will not be controlled.

quotes.name: Imp's Mischief
quotes.flavor: Rude Rascal Robs Rube's Robes

quotes.name: Jeskai Banner
quotes.flavor: Discipline to persevere, insight to discover.

quotes.name: Hinterland Harbor
quotes.flavor:
"Our ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship, then built our town on its hull. We're pretty proud of that."
—Alene of Riverspan

quotes.name: Festival Crasher
quotes.flavor: So many candles. So many flammables. So little time.

quotes.name: Impassioned Orator
quotes.flavor: In times of unrest, the crowd is eager for the comfort of strong convictions.

quotes.name: Elephant-Rat
quotes.flavor:
"The rats that scurried across the floor of my cage were nothing more than skins filled with liquid."
—Hama

quotes.name: Rampant Growth
quotes.flavor: Rath forces plants from its surface as one presses whey from cheese.

quotes.name: Shalai's Acolyte
quotes.flavor: Armed by Multani, she protected the forest from above.

quotes.name: Feast on the Fallen
quotes.flavor: He only paused to catch his breath, not knowing that it would be his last.

quotes.name: Baba Lysaga, Night Witch
quotes.flavor: Better the cold night than her warm hospitality.

quotes.name: Shivan Reef
quotes.flavor: The boiling seas around Shiv provided a welcome layer of protection for the reclaimed Mana Rig.

quotes.name: Soul Manipulation
quotes.flavor:
"Birth and death are both reversible."
—Nicol Bolas

quotes.name: Divine Transformation
quotes.flavor: Glory surged through her and radiance surrounded her. All things were possible with the blessing of the Divine.

quotes.name: Aquamoeba
quotes.flavor: Some tides need no moon.

quotes.name: Gisa and Geralf
quotes.flavor:
"These fiends are slightly less tolerable than you."
"A sentiment that warms my heart, sister."

quotes.name: Backup Agent
quotes.flavor: "My sources say the Beamtown Bullies were spotted in the Mezzio. Keep your eyes sharp and stay close to me."

quotes.name: Eron the Relentless
quotes.flavor:
"Eron would be much less of a hassle if only he were mortal."
—Reyhan, Samite Alchemist

quotes.name: Anguished Unmaking
quotes.flavor: James flooded the room with radiation, ensuring Project Purity would not fall into Enclave hands. With his last breath, he told his child to run.

quotes.name: Wall of Blossoms
quotes.flavor: Each flower identical, every leaf and petal disturbingly exact.

quotes.name: Goblin Tunneler
quotes.flavor: "The best way over the mountain is through."

quotes.name: Velukan Dragon
quotes.flavor: The most powerful among them, Ashuza rules Veluk with flame and claw.

quotes.name: Skillful Lunge
quotes.flavor:
"Valor is a currency of the living that serves us well."
—Cosper Lowe of the Silbern Guard

quotes.name: Drown in Dreams
quotes.flavor: . . . submerged in reveries, gasping for reality . . .

quotes.name: Vengeance
quotes.flavor:
"It is the duty of the strong to oppose any who threaten the weak."
—The Southern Paladin

quotes.name: Ravenous Intruder
quotes.flavor:
"I've made some fine acquisitions of late, so I'm planning to make commensurate improvements to my security systems. I have a consultant coming tomorrow."
—Kurna Majan, Luminary League

quotes.name: Feldon of the Third Path
quotes.flavor: "She will come back to me."

quotes.name: Gorilla Warrior
quotes.flavor: The gorilla beat its chest and threw great handfuls of leaves into the air. It howled challenge and showed its teeth. The mechanical soldier, not understanding, simply killed it.

quotes.name: Feral Hydra
quotes.flavor: It shreds its prey as each head fights for the choicest bits.

quotes.name: Vindicate
quotes.flavor:
"Hol visto intere civiltà. sorgere e crollare. Voi mortali non siete che polvere per me."
—Sorin Markov

quotes.name: Dwynen's Elite
quotes.flavor: Call one, call them all.

quotes.name: Watcher Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"I have spied them, wandering and watching—but for what? I fear they watch for us."
—Yonat of Amrou

quotes.name: Grasping Scoundrel
quotes.flavor: "I can hear the plunder calling. It asks for me by name."

quotes.name: Rogue's Passage
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

quotes.name: Ishi-Ishi, Akki Crackshot
quotes.flavor:
"Here fell Ishi-Ishi, King of the Flaming Pebbles, Scourge of the Mountain Kami, Lover of Goats. May his shell never burn."
—Cave inscription

quotes.name: Forced Landing
quotes.flavor: The druid knew only one spell, a charm to encourage rapid plant growth. When airborne Eternals invaded her arboretum, she had to get creative.

quotes.name: Foam Weapons Kiosk
quotes.flavor:
"I'm sorry, ma'am. Sometimes a real sword just sneaks its way in there."
—Randa, day care blacksmith

quotes.name: Crushing Canopy
quotes.flavor:
"The forests of this world are unafraid to assert themselves."
—Wrenn

quotes.name: Vow of Lightning
quotes.flavor:
"For all I have lost, for all who have fallen, I will render you to dust."
—Jared Carthalion

quotes.name: Ambush
quotes.flavor:
"Don't these goons have anything better to do?"
—Joskun, An-Havva Constable

quotes.name: Clown Extruder
quotes.flavor: "CONGRATULATIONS. IT IS A CLOWN."

quotes.name: Schema Thief
quotes.flavor: "An intriguing design, but it would be much better without all that oil."

quotes.name: Mistcaller
quotes.flavor: Hospitality is of little concern to those who do not wish to be disturbed.

quotes.name: Aven Flock
quotes.flavor: Just as each added feather steadies the wing, so does the flock grow stronger with each new member.

quotes.name: Imp's Mischief
quotes.flavor:
"Do the innocent pay for the crimes of the guilty? Of course they do. That's the fate of the weak."
—Nicol Bolas

quotes.name: Overrun
quotes.flavor: Nature doesn't walk.

quotes.name: Fear
quotes.flavor:
"The horror! The horror!"
—Joseph Conrad, *Heart of Darkness*

quotes.name: Sigil of Sleep
quotes.flavor: Arrows are only one way to remove an enemy.

quotes.name: Pledge of Loyalty
quotes.flavor: Urza convinced many Dominarians not only to set aside their differences, but to embrace them.

quotes.name: Triskaidekaphile
quotes.flavor: "Thirteen aces. Read 'em and weep."

quotes.name: Cloudkin Seer
quotes.flavor: "I can see which way the wind is blowing."

quotes.name: Jalum Tome
quotes.flavor: Most books simply deliver knowledge. This one expects some in return.

quotes.name: Grip of Phyresis
quotes.flavor:
"Even your blade knows who will triumph here."
—Atraxa, Praetors' Voice

quotes.name: Blood Artist
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor:
"Vanya Falkenrath's paintings are astonishing. How does she manage to achieve such rich crimson hues?"
—Stefan, art critic

quotes.name: Harmonize
quotes.flavor: "Words lie. People lie. The land tells the truth."

quotes.name: Giant Growth
quotes.flavor:
"Sometimes Mowu is content to gnaw on a bone. Sometimes he wants the whole skeleton."
—Jiang Yanggu

quotes.name: Oath of Jace
quotes.flavor: "For the sake of the Multiverse, I will keep watch."

quotes.name: Caregiver
quotes.flavor: "The guilds each believe its way is right, but their ways only bring blood to Ravnica's streets and tears to Ravnica's families."

quotes.name: Stone Rain
quotes.flavor:
I cast a thousand tiny suns—
Beware my many dawns.

quotes.name: No Mercy
quotes.flavor:
"We had years to prepare, while they had mere minutes."
—Kerrick, sleeper agent

quotes.name: Ajani's Anguish
quotes.flavor: The memory trap tormented Ajani. "Time's up, brother," said Jazal's voice inside his head. "Your vengeance, or your friends. What will it be?"

quotes.name: Student of Ojutai
quotes.flavor: "Human enlightenment is a firefly that sparks in the night. Dragon enlightenment is a beacon that disperses all darkness."

quotes.name: Cancel
quotes.flavor: "What you are attempting is not against the law. It is, however, extremely foolish."

quotes.name: Birds of Paradise
quotes.flavor: Sages whisper of an undiscovered natural paradise, a tropical island unspoiled by war.

quotes.name: Ruby, Daring Tracker
quotes.flavor: Neither the sharpest thorns nor the foulest beasts would stop her from finding her brother.

quotes.name: Ulna Alley Shopkeep
quotes.flavor: "This one's from my private stock."

quotes.name: Ixidor's Will
quotes.flavor: "Some dreams should not come to be."

quotes.name: Temple of Malady
quotes.flavor: The world ended, yet the ads kept rolling.

quotes.name: Metathran Elite
quotes.flavor: If the eyes are windows to the soul, their souls are not of this world.

quotes.name: Recollect
quotes.flavor:
"The bones of the past will tell their tales—if you know how to speak their language."
—Savra

quotes.name: Jungle Hollow
quotes.flavor: On the surface of Ixalan's vast tar pits, Phyrexian oil glistened, and old bones began to stir.

quotes.name: Jack-o'-Lantern
quotes.flavor: By the end of the festival, it was the only thing still grinning.

quotes.name: Realm of Koh
quotes.flavor: Aang delved deep into the spiraling depths in search of wherever Koh called home.

quotes.name: Maze Skullbomb
quotes.flavor: It pulses with the might of an apex predator.

quotes.name: Amaranthine Wall
quotes.flavor: Neither its appearance nor its temperature varies as the years pass, an eternal testament to the forces that shaped Dominaria.

quotes.name: Trespasser il-Vec
quotes.flavor: At the epicenter of the Rathi overlay, the City of Traitors did not align with Dominaria. Many of its inhabitants were caught between the two worlds.

quotes.name: Blackbloom Rogue // Blackbloom Bog
quotes.flavor:
"The Raimunza River flows along the branches of jaddi trees for miles before plunging down to feed Blackbloom Lake."
—Exena, expedition rogue

quotes.name: Reclamation Sage
quotes.flavor: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

quotes.name: Tyrant's Familiar
quotes.flavor: Nothing escapes its gaze—or its breath.

quotes.name: Curse of the Nightly Hunt
quotes.flavor: When the moon rises and the bloodlust takes hold, nothing matters but the kill.

quotes.name: Wall of Fire
quotes.flavor:
"Struggle, and you will only fan the flames."
—Talibah, embermage

quotes.name: Second Guess
quotes.flavor:
"I see where you're going with that. I don't like it."
—Dierk, geistmage

quotes.name: Shimmer Dragon
quotes.flavor: The indigo dragon gladly traded a bit of its hoard for everlasting moonlight.

quotes.name: Vinelasher Kudzu
quotes.flavor: It grows to hate you.

quotes.name: Sword-Point Diplomacy
quotes.flavor: "Take my blood if you want. Just don't take my gold!"

quotes.name: Counterspell
quotes.flavor:
"It was probably a lousy spell in the first place."
—Ertai, wizard adept

quotes.name: Confiscate
quotes.flavor:
"The surface world contains nothing I cannot take."
—The Lord of Atlantis

quotes.name: Woodland Acolyte // Mend the Wilds
quotes.flavor: He left knighthood behind to heal the scars of the invasion.

quotes.name: Scute Swarm
quotes.flavor:
"Survival rule 782: There are *always* more scute bugs."
—Zurdi, goblin shortcutter

quotes.name: Loxodon Warhammer
quotes.flavor:
"A crafter must imbue her weapon with part of her soul—something the Phyrexians are incapable of doing."
—Melira

quotes.name: Blight Grenade
quotes.flavor: Blight grenades—which induce horrendous effects on their victims—have no impact on the Death Guard, who gladly use the devices in extreme close quarters with the enemy.

quotes.name: Valorous Stance
quotes.flavor:
"Every choice alters the path of fate."
—Sarkhan Vol

quotes.name: Scarscale Ritual
quotes.flavor: Some words are too important to trust to something as fragile as memory.

quotes.name: Shock
quotes.flavor:
"The beauty of it is they never see it coming. Ever."
—Razzix, sparkmage

quotes.name: Isperia, Supreme Judge
quotes.flavor: "I serve only justice. But through that duty, I serve all of Ravnica."

quotes.name: Workshop Elders
quotes.flavor:
"Fear not what's under the bed. The toys are watching."
—*Beyond the Great Henge*

quotes.name: Mistfolk
quotes.flavor:
"Although my official log will state there is no evidence pointing to the existence of the mistfolk, my certainty is lessened by the cursed consistency of the expedition's eyewitness accounts."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

quotes.name: Serra's Boon
quotes.flavor:
"The light of an angel's glance is warm, but her fixed stare blinds and burns."
—Calexis, deacon of the New Order of Serra

quotes.name: Oakshade Stalker // Moonlit Ambusher
quotes.flavor: Even when he strikes, the only sound is the snap of jaws through bone.

quotes.name: Whiptail Wurm
quotes.flavor: It's hard to say for certain which end is more dangerous.

quotes.name: Luminous Broodmoth
quotes.flavor: It soars through currents of moonbeams to give hope to the forsaken.

quotes.name: Kodama's Reach
quotes.flavor:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

quotes.name: Loamcrafter Faun
quotes.flavor: "Give me just a moment. I need to grow us a new bridge."

quotes.name: Argothian Elder
quotes.flavor:
Sharpen your ears
—Elvish expression meaning "grow wiser"

quotes.name: Run Away Together
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: True love means always knowing what's on the other's mind.

quotes.name: Mark of Mutiny
quotes.flavor: The flame of anger is hard to douse once lit.

quotes.name: Sengir Vampire
quotes.flavor: Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.

quotes.name: Dizzying Gaze
quotes.flavor:
"When I cut down my angel I only started my fall."
—Crovax

quotes.name: Hand of Silumgar
quotes.flavor: Silumgar trains those whom he favors in his magic, granting them the ability to spread his disdain across the land.

quotes.name: Rampant Growth
quotes.flavor: Rath forces plants from its surface as one presses whey from cheese.

quotes.name: Wild Mongrel
quotes.flavor: It teaches *you* to play dead.

quotes.name: Toby, Beastie Befriender
quotes.flavor: "Sure, I'm pretty small, but Gribble isn't, so I don't get scared."

quotes.name: Cryptolith Rite
quotes.flavor: The chant was incomprehensible, but its power was unmistakable.

quotes.name: Bloodsworn Steward
quotes.flavor: "My liege will lead and I will follow—to the battlefield, to the grave, and beyond."

quotes.name: Blood Crypt
quotes.flavor: Life is a show, and death its final performance.

quotes.name: Ravenous Rats
quotes.flavor: Nothing is sacred to the rats. Everything is simply another meal.

quotes.name: Dream Pillager
quotes.flavor: Its wings shimmer with dreams absorbed from its enemies.

quotes.name: Looming Shade
quotes.flavor: On darkness feeding, in nightmares breeding.

quotes.name: Alms Collector
quotes.flavor: "There is no justice when some profit and others go without."

quotes.name: Pygmy Pyrosaur
quotes.flavor:
Do not judge a lizard by its size.
—Ghitu proverb

quotes.name: March from the Tomb
quotes.flavor: They came from all walks of life, from every part of Zendikar, and they returned with one unifying cause.

quotes.name: Rewind
quotes.flavor: "Let's go over this one more time. . . ."

quotes.name: Reassembling Skeleton
quotes.flavor:
"They may show up with the wrong thigh bone or mandible, but they always show up."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

quotes.name: Serra Angel
quotes.flavor: When she flies above the good, they consider themselves blessed. When she flies above the wicked, they consider themselves dead.

quotes.name: Tenacity
quotes.flavor:
"Deep in the ugliness of war, she appeared to remind us of the love for which we fight."
—Syr Agata of Ardenvale

quotes.name: Trade Route Envoy
quotes.flavor: The Abzan pride themselves on the safety of their roads. To reject their escorts invites storm and sorrow.

quotes.name: Village Rites
quotes.flavor: "You were so eager to take and consume. Yet when asked to give, you refuse?"

quotes.name: Meltdown
quotes.flavor: Catastrophes happened so often at the mana rig that the viashino language had a special word to describe them.

quotes.name: Deathcap Glade
quotes.flavor: Deadly mushrooms litter these woods, each waiting for an errant footstep to release its noxious spores.

quotes.name: Anthousa, Setessan Hero
quotes.flavor: The warriors she leads can rarely keep pace with her, and neither can the tales.

quotes.name: Shrine Steward
quotes.flavor: From broken swords, the first Imperials forged a peaceful servant to tend the shrines of Eiganjo.

quotes.name: Opera Love Song
quotes.flavor: "O my hero, my beloved, shall we still be made to part?"

quotes.name: Golgari Germination
quotes.flavor: The Golgari don't bury their dead. They plant them.

quotes.name: Deadbridge Shaman
quotes.flavor: Ending her life won't end the infestation.

quotes.name: Cyclonic Rift
quotes.flavor:
「自然の底力を目の当たりにしたとき......自分がその力に抗えると思わぬことだ。」
――「嵐大工の文書」

quotes.name: Anurid Swarmsnapper
quotes.flavor: Anurids have the problem of airborne invaders licked.

quotes.name: Treasure Trove
quotes.flavor:
"Wealth means power; the power to subdue, to crush, to exploit, the power to enslave, to outrage, to degrade."
—Emma Goldman, "Anarchism"

quotes.name: Coiling Oracle
quotes.flavor: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

quotes.name: Angelic Edict
quotes.flavor: The Boros built a prison in the sky where Azorius statutes couldn't restrict their sense of justice.

quotes.name: Photon, Lady of Light
quotes.flavor: In the darkest times, she shines brightest.

quotes.name: Carrion Screecher
quotes.flavor: The banished have come home to roost.

quotes.name: Ichor Wellspring
quotes.flavor:
"Our glorious infection has taken hold."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

quotes.name: Faebloom Trick
quotes.flavor:
"A face full of pollen? That's probably the nicest thing a faerie will ever give you!"
—Calydd, kithkin farmer

quotes.name: Bloodline Culling
quotes.flavor: "Forget your human ancestors. You're part of my family now."

quotes.name: Jungle Shrine
quotes.flavor: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

quotes.name: Bog Wraith
quotes.flavor: It moved through the troops leaving no footprints, save on their souls.

quotes.name: Suppression Ray // Orderly Plaza
quotes.flavor:
"Chaos fuels the flames of violence. Only through order can peace be assured."
—Dovin Baan

quotes.name: Hedgewitch's Mask
quotes.flavor: In Kessig, even celebration wears a fearsome face.

quotes.name: Guilty Conscience
quotes.flavor:
Those who most feel guilt don't need to, while those who most need to feel guilt never do.
—Order proverb

quotes.name: Cracked Earth Technique
quotes.flavor: Against Toph, an army's greatest mistake is touching the ground.

quotes.name: Pulmonic Sliver
quotes.flavor: Like a great bellows it hisses, and its kin, both living and dead, are lifted to safety.

quotes.name: Your Nightmares Are Delicious
quotes.flavor: "I will craft exquisite tortures from the roiling depths of your terrified mind."

quotes.name: Moldervine Reclamation
quotes.flavor:
"The heroes of the past nourish our spirits by their example—and nourish our crops by their decay."
—Jeddeg, philosopher of graves

quotes.name: Legion Vanguard
quotes.flavor: It takes guts to be a trailblazer.

quotes.name: Mist-Cloaked Herald
quotes.flavor: With matchless stealth, the River Heralds fought a running battle against the three enemy forces.

quotes.name: Ravenous Rats
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Garruk vs. Liliana
quotes.flavor: Nothing is sacred to rats. Everything is simply another meal.

quotes.name: Exotic Orchard
quotes.flavor: In the late stages of a Tyranid invasion, sessile organisms take root in a planet's crust, converting its resources into biomass that can be extracted by the Hive Fleet.

quotes.name: Aven Envoy
quotes.flavor: Their grieving faces tell far more than a list of casualties ever could.

quotes.name: Vulshok Sorcerer
quotes.flavor: Vulshok sorcerers train by leaping into electrified storm clouds. Dead or alive, they come back down with smiles on their faces.

quotes.name: Teferi's Imp
quotes.flavor: Made you look.

quotes.name: Frankie Peanuts
quotes.flavor: Don't cross him or you'll end up sleeping with the merfolk.

quotes.name: Cerodon Yearling
quotes.flavor: The unit of measurement used to chart a cerodon's growth is "persons consumed."

quotes.name: Zephyr Falcon
quotes.flavor: Although greatly prized among falconers, the Zephyr Falcon is capricious and not easily tamed.

quotes.name: Kaervek the Merciless
quotes.flavor:
"Rats and jackals feast in his swath, but even they will not walk with him."
—Mangara

quotes.name: Village Rites
quotes.flavor: "You were so eager to take and consume. Yet when asked to give, you refuse?"

quotes.name: Frantic Search
quotes.flavor: It took the banning of temporal manipulation at Tolaria West to teach its students the value of time.

quotes.name: Hemosymbic Mite
quotes.flavor: By stimulating violent behavior in its host, the mite scavenges the remains of prey much too large for it to hunt on its own.

quotes.name: Last Chance
quotes.flavor: "I only had time to read half the spell, but I'm pretty sure this will work!"

quotes.name: Young Wolf
quotes.flavor: The Ulvenwald makes no allowances for youth. Today's newborn is either tomorrow's hunter or tomorrow's lunch.

quotes.name: Nasty Little Rabbit
quotes.flavor: Beorn's fences kept out Goblins and unwanted intruders, not hungry rabbits.

quotes.name: Elturel Survivors
quotes.flavor: They fought with the desperate courage of those who have nothing left to lose.

quotes.name: Woolly Thoctar
quotes.flavor: One of the most ferocious and deadly gargantuans, the thoctar never sees its worshippers, but it often awakens surrounded by gifts and sacrifices.

quotes.name: Arc Lightning
quotes.flavor: Rainclouds don't last long in Shiv, but that doesn't stop the lightning.

quotes.name: Crawling Barrens
quotes.flavor: Zendikar is restless.

quotes.name: Reckless Fireweaver
quotes.flavor: Architects find inspiration in the dragon's beauty of form, while artificers are influenced by the function of its fire.

quotes.name: Haldir, Lórien Lieutenant
quotes.flavor: "Now you must be brought before the Lord and the Lady."

quotes.name: Mirror-Shield Hoplite
quotes.flavor: In the shield's gleaming surface, the Phyrexian saw a reflection of what it once had been, and paused.

quotes.name: Atarka, World Render
quotes.flavor:
"Her hunger knows no limit. Left unchecked, she would feast on all of Tarkir."
—Yasova Dragonclaw

quotes.name: Wayward Giant
quotes.flavor:
"The giants follow the flow of aether, and twice a year it leads them through here. Lesson learned. More clearance is needed."
—Sram, senior edificer

quotes.name: Keen-Eyed Curator
quotes.flavor: "Now this one's a real collector's item. They say Lily Emberseed herself drank from this mug when she was still Lily of Valley."

quotes.name: Barrage of Expendables
quotes.flavor: Goblin generals don't distinguish between troops and ammunition.

quotes.name: Nourish
quotes.flavor: Gelfruit grows abundantly wherever Sylvok druids live, as if the Tangle knows that humans are not as hardy as the beasts or as nimble as the elves.

quotes.name: Gurmag Angler
quotes.flavor: If everything in the Gurmag Swamp hungers for human flesh, what bait could be more effective?

quotes.name: Ethereal Ambush
quotes.flavor: The energies of the Temur lands are readily unleashed upon intruders.

quotes.name: Leyline Axe
quotes.flavor: It awaits a worthy wielder.

quotes.name: Kamahl, Pit Fighter
quotes.flavor: Cuando la libertad parece perdida, se levantan grandes almas para recobrarla.

quotes.name: Blue Sun's Twilight
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Promos
quotes.flavor:
"Where once there was ignorance, Jin-Gitaxias brought knowledge, and an age of progress dawned."
—Monument inscription

quotes.name: Persecute
quotes.flavor:
"Of all the tyrannies on humane kind
The worst is that which persecutes the mind."
—John Dryden,
"The Hind and the Panther"

quotes.name: Flux Channeler
quotes.flavor: "Inform our allies in the Tenth and throw the circuit. It's about to get weird."

quotes.name: Felidar Sovereign
quotes.flavor: When the mighty king snickers, victory is close at hand.

quotes.name: Disciplined Duelist
quotes.flavor: Brokers agents defend their charges by all means available, from intricate logic to blunt force trauma.

quotes.name: Dalkovan Packbeasts
quotes.flavor:
A burden shared is a burden lightened.
—Mardu proverb

quotes.name: Reflexes
quotes.flavor:
"Here's how ya win. Don't let the other guy hit back first."
—Jula, goblin raider

quotes.name: Prismari Campus
quotes.flavor: Mage-students who see spellcraft as the highest form of expression choose Prismari, the college of elemental arts.

quotes.name: Will, Scion of Peace
quotes.flavor: "It's easy to cry 'For glory!' and charge those who disagree with you. But it takes finesse to turn enemies into allies rather than corpses."

quotes.name: Overgrown Battlement
quotes.flavor:
"Our enemy is nothing less than the end of all life. We shall not want for allies."
—*The War Diaries*

quotes.name: Curtains' Call
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"We give the audience what they want."
—Juri, proprietor of the Juri Revue

quotes.name: Ragged Recluse // Odious Witch
quotes.flavor: Her cauldron refilled, she settled in to wait for the next unsuspecting traveler to knock at her door.

quotes.name: Viashivan Dragon
quotes.flavor: The Viashivan understand that cruelty arises from opportunity.

quotes.name: Explosive Vegetation
quotes.flavor: Torching Krosa would be pointless. It grows faster than it burns.

quotes.name: Wild Aesthir
quotes.flavor:
"What Barbarian secrets do they spy from their lofty perch?"
—General Varchild

quotes.name: Flame Javelin
quotes.flavor: Gyara Spearhurler would have been renowned for her deadly accuracy, if it weren't for her deadly accuracy.

quotes.name: Popular Entertainer
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: The last thing anyone would describe you as is shy. You love the spotlight, and it loves you back.

quotes.name: Elvish Visionary
quotes.flavor: "If you cling to the safety of the roots, you'll never climb high enough to see through the canopy."

quotes.name: Rishadan Cutpurse
quotes.flavor:
The bigger the purse, the greater the fool.
—Rishadan saying

quotes.name: Felothar, Dawn of the Abzan
quotes.flavor: "Through perennation, we stand together, families—ancestor and kin─united as one clan! Abzan!"

quotes.name: Plated Crusher
quotes.flavor:
"It might fight the Eldrazi, but don't mistake it for a companion, Gideon. It's not interested in your concept of strength through unity."
—Najiya, leader of the Tajuru

quotes.name: Mother of Runes
quotes.flavor: "My family protects all families."

quotes.name: Hellkite Igniter
quotes.flavor: Its flight sets the sky itself on fire.

quotes.name: Dismember
quotes.flavor:
"Strip away pain, struggle, impurity, fear, flesh. Surrender the pieces and be blessed as one."
—*Phyrexian Scriptures*

quotes.name: Consider
quotes.flavor: Ivold gasped in surprise. Either a very strange insect had crawled onto one of the lenses or he was seeing geists at last!

quotes.name: Bog-Strider Ash
quotes.flavor: "If you want to test wisdom, offer it to fools and watch how they tear it up."

quotes.name: Conduit of Storms // Conduit of Emrakul
quotes.flavor: As without, so within.

quotes.name: Sygg, River Guide
quotes.flavor: "If there's a place worth going, the Merrow Lanes already do. And if there's a route worth taking, yours truly already has."

quotes.name: Defenestrate
quotes.flavor: The chaplain would perhaps have found some small comfort had he known that the replacement window would be named in his honor.

quotes.name: Cori Mountain Stalwart
quotes.flavor: Zhao had resolved to hold the bridge, defending the village behind him. But the villagers decided Zhao would not stand alone.

quotes.name: Execute
quotes.flavor:
"Any fool who would die for honor is better off dead."
—Cabal Patriarch

quotes.name: Seedborn Muse
quotes.flavor:
"Her voice is the wilderness, savage and pure."
—Kamahl, druid acolyte

quotes.name: Sudden Strength
quotes.flavor: The Mirari's magic transformed the Krosan Forest—and its inhabitants.

quotes.name: Hull Breach
quotes.flavor: "Crovax knows we're coming now," said a grinning Sisay. "I just sent the *Predator* crashing into his stronghold."

quotes.name: Spectral Searchlight
quotes.flavor: The first searchlights were given as gifts, symbols of cooperation, to the emissaries present at the signing of the Guildpact.

quotes.name: Desynchronization
quotes.flavor: History cannot be changed, and the Animus is not kind to those who try.

quotes.name: Youthful Valkyrie
quotes.flavor: Helle soared joyfully through the icy dawn. After hearing one thousand tales of her ancestors, she'd finally taken her place among the honored host.

quotes.name: Song of Serenity
quotes.flavor: Heartwood brings peace in great symphonies where dryads conduct the trees through every note.

quotes.name: Archon of the Wild Rose
quotes.flavor: The curse of Redtooth Keep could only be broken by a mystical rose that blooms in moonlight.

quotes.name: Lifetap
quotes.flavor:
Keep a green tree in your heart and perhaps the singing bird will come.
—Chinese proverb

quotes.name: Brindle Shoat
quotes.flavor: Hunters lure the stripling boar into the open, hoping to trap greater prey.

quotes.name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
quotes.flavor: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

quotes.name: Allied Assault
quotes.flavor: A common foe is the death of old hatreds.

quotes.name: Contaminated Aquifer
quotes.flavor: The caves stretch farther than anyone knows, and the terrible legacy of Yawgmoth lurks in every shadow.

quotes.name: Dreamshaper Shaman
quotes.flavor: Magic is the true artist's medium.

quotes.name: Grizzly Bears
quotes.flavor: Don't try to outrun one of Dominia's Grizzlies; it'll catch you, knock you down, and eat you. Of course, you could run up a tree. In that case you'll get a nice view before it knocks the tree down and eats you.

quotes.name: Leave in the Dust
quotes.flavor: The daredevil racers of the Derby Crows, long at odds with the Consulate, were quick to join the renegades in open revolt.

quotes.name: Paradise Druid
quotes.flavor: "Hello again, my metamorphic friends. What stories have you brought to tell me today?"

quotes.name: Moonstone Harbinger
quotes.flavor: Moonstone weapons drink in the last light of dusk to give their wielders an edge in combat.

quotes.name: Gerrard's Wisdom
quotes.flavor: A picture is worth a thousand swords.

quotes.name: Trail of Evidence
quotes.flavor:
"Every answer seems to lead to a more terrifying question."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Demolish
quotes.flavor:
"When fire is shackled to candle and torch, subjected to insignificance, it finds a way to lash out at its masters."
—Vala, disciple of Purphoros

quotes.name: Ogre Slumlord
quotes.flavor:
"His tenement is filled with the most vile, disgusting vermin. It's infested with rats, too."
—Branko One-Ear

quotes.name: Highland Lake
quotes.flavor: With the fate of Innistrad uncertain, some seek solace in remote areas.

quotes.name: Terminal Velocity
quotes.flavor: A victory was the best retirement gift the admiral could have asked for.

quotes.name: Curse of Obsession
quotes.flavor: He ripped up board after board until his hands were bloody. Still, he could not find whatever it was he sought.

quotes.name: Gitaxian Anatomist
quotes.flavor: An inconsistency in a routine vivisection sparked a revelation about the inner workings of the Orthodoxy's centurions.

quotes.name: Wojek Investigator
quotes.flavor: "Well, this clearly didn't come from anyone I know..."

quotes.name: Sunscorch Regent
quotes.flavor:
"We trust in the scalelords, bringers of justice that none can escape."
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

quotes.name: Rambunctious Mutt
quotes.flavor: Emphatic words with powerful gestures. Clearly this was playtime.

quotes.name: Take Down
quotes.flavor: The drake flew true. The arrow flew truer.

quotes.name: I Am Never Alone
quotes.flavor: "This is but a pale shadow of my true form. Cower before it, and despair."

quotes.name: Giant Spider
quotes.flavor: While it possesses potent venom, the Giant Spider often chooses not to paralyze its victims. Perhaps the creature enjoys the gentle rocking motion caused by its captives' struggles to escape its web.

quotes.name: Jungleborn Pioneer
quotes.flavor: "We fought so long to hide this place. Let us be first to learn its wonders!"

quotes.name: Nest Invader
quotes.flavor: It nurtures its masters' glorious future.

quotes.name: Mold Shambler
quotes.flavor: When civilization encroaches on nature, Zendikar encroaches back.

quotes.name: Explosive Getaway
quotes.flavor: Loot decided he liked these rescuers much more than the last ones.

quotes.name: Disciple of the Vault
quotes.flavor: He stands in the shadow of his lord, Geth, drinking in the dark energies of the Vault.

quotes.name: Idol of Oblivion
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor: "Arise, great one, and cleanse the world of our enemies!"

quotes.name: Garenbrig Carver // Shield's Might
quotes.flavor: Countless knights of Garenbrig owe their lives to his peerless craftsmanship.

quotes.name: Laquatus's Champion
quotes.flavor: Темный дар Чейнера еще более темной душе.

quotes.name: Fluctuator
quotes.flavor:
"It generates power by harnessing the nature of possibility itself."
"But will it work?"
". . . Possibly."

quotes.name: Durkwood Boars
quotes.flavor:
"And the unclean spirits went out, and entered the swine: and the herd ran violently . . . ."
—Mark 5:13

quotes.name: Archers' Parapet
quotes.flavor: Every shaft is graven with a name from a kin tree, calling upon the spirits of the ancestors to make it fly true.

quotes.name: Bosh, Iron Golem
quotes.flavor: As Glissa searches for the truth about Memnarch, Bosh searches to unearth the secrets of his past.

quotes.name: Goblin Grenadiers
quotes.flavor: For once, Squee realized, *he* wasn't the dumb one.

quotes.name: Red Cliffs Armada
quotes.flavor: By the battle of Red Cliffs in the year 208, the Wu kingdom controlled more than seven thousand warships on the Yangtze.

quotes.name: Jenara, Asura of War
quotes.flavor: Wounded soldiers looked up, grateful for her appearance. But she passed over them, her eyes firmly on their foe.

quotes.name: Kjeldoran Phalanx
quotes.flavor:
"There's nothing I like better than watching a street full of soldiers kicking down the doors of the guilty and the impure."
—Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald

quotes.name: Pondering Mage
quotes.flavor: "Never leave the future to fate."

quotes.name: Fracture
quotes.flavor:
"Your defiance is amusing, little mage. It's time you learn how fragile you really are."
—Extus Narr

quotes.name: Torbran, Thane of Red Fell
quotes.flavor: A dwarf's grudge runs deeper than the mountains' roots.

quotes.name: Voracious Greatshark
quotes.flavor: There is no boat big enough.

quotes.name: Beast Whisperer
quotes.flavor: "No symphony can compare to the melody of the ferrox's roar."
